patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-width content and two-column layouts (image + text), often with the image occupying more than half the width, creating an asymmetrical balance.

A strong typographic hierarchy is established through the use of large, elegant serif headings for primary titles, contrasted with clean, readable sans-serif for body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels.
The site predominantly uses a muted, light beige background with dark grey text, accented by subtle light blue/teal for emphasis and black for high-contrast elements like CTAs and the footer.

A full-screen modal with a semi-transparent backdrop and centered content box appears with a fade and slight scale animation, obscuring the main content. This specific animation is observed in the provided scroll sequence, rather than scroll-triggered content reveals.
Content sections are clearly delineated by generous vertical whitespace and often introduced by a prominent, centered heading, creating a calm and unhurried reading experience.

technique_notes: The hero section features a full-bleed background image with a subtle, dark gradient overlay to ensure high contrast and readability for the centered, light-colored text.
Interactive elements like circular diagrams or progress indicators likely use CSS keyframes or GSAP to animate their lines or fill states, providing subtle visual engagement.

Content sections and individual elements (text blocks, images, circular profile pictures) are likely revealed with a staggered fade-up or slide-in animation as they enter the viewport, utilizing GSAP ScrollTrigger for a smooth, engaging scroll experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, elegant serif headings (H1 ~4-5x body, H2 ~3x body) with generous letter spacing, paired with a clean, legible sans-serif body text and smaller, often uppercase, sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle (mostly sharp corners, with very slight rounding on interactive elements and circular profile images).
design_tokens.spacing: Airy (very generous vertical spacing between sections and within content blocks, creating a calm, unhurried feel).

standout: The site's design is distinctive for its exceptionally airy layout and the sophisticated pairing of elegant, high-contrast serif headings with clean sans-serif body text. This, combined with a muted, earthy color palette and serene imagery, creates a deeply calming and almost spiritual user experience that transcends typical marketing aesthetics.
